title: Complete essential MIR 3.2.5 research-cost correctness
migration_impact: Keep public 3.2.3 as the sole predecessor; preserve stable technology and setting IDs, neutral defaults, selected research, completed science-unit work, queues, unrelated force state, and one effective owner; require an idempotent second reload for every governed direct-upgrade archetype; and create no 2.5.5 release authority.
release_note_impact: MIR 3.2.5 validates fixed, linear, exponential, and hybrid research costs with algebraic positivity and monotonicity proof, explicit numeric and parser budgets, exact 3.2.3 default vectors, two-reload upgrade proof, owner removal and transfer dispositions, and explicit Factorio 2.0 dispositions for every shipped feature.

backport_disposition.factorio-2.1: apply as the final package-visible essential 325-B1 correction before source freeze
backport_disposition.factorio-2.0: retain the explicit shipped-feature disposition inventory only; bind exact runtime realization after public 3.2.5 and a positive feasibility decision
